children: Rimini reinstated Steven Hershkowitz as Executive Vice President and Chief Revenue Officer, effective September 14, 2026.
Executive Vice President and Chief Revenue Officer
Reinstated per mutual agreement following prior resignation on September 8, 2026
Chief Revenue Officer responsibilities reassigned from Keith Costello back to Hershkowitz; no change to Costello's employment arrangement

Joined Rimini Street in April 2024; previously CRO at Virtana (Feb 2022–Apr 2024) and held multiple roles at Hewlett Packard Enterprise (Apr 2010–Feb 2022); U.S. Air Force veteran; studied Business Administration and Management at University of Maryland
